scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace server & npm run dev --workspace web && wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build:server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/src/index.ts server/src/db/migra.ts server/src/avvio.ts server/src/importa.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=server/dist --outbase=server/src --packages=external && cp server/src/db/schema.sql server/dist/db/schema.sql
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web
